name: Aurora 2-Way
tagline: A two-way bookshelf with a handmade wooden waveguide
story:
## Why this design

The Aurora started as an experiment in **waveguide directivity** matching. The goal was a smooth handoff between the 1" dome and the 6.5" mid-woofer at around 1.8 kHz.

### Key choices

- 1" soft dome with a 3D-printed waveguide, Q ~ 0.7
- Sealed 14 L enclosure, tuned for an F3 of 48 Hz
- First-order electrical / acoustic target via a minimal-parts crossover

> The crossover ended up simpler than planned — the waveguide did most of the work.

The measured responses came out within 2 dB from 80 Hz to 20 kHz on-axis.

1. Design the waveguide first
2. Pick the tweeter that fits it
3. Simulate, build, measure, iterate
